**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant on the Company. I searched for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" and read both operative sections in full:

- The only restrictive covenants are in **Section 6 (Exclusivity)** — a product/site exclusivity on the Company (6.1) and a two-year post-term competing-project restriction that runs **against HDI only** (6.3), which benefits us and is not flagged here.
- **Section 5.4** is only a mutual General Manager/liaison appointment, not a personnel covenant (consistent with the planner's hint).
- **Section 10.7 (Entire Agreement)** confirms no hiring restriction is imported from any other document.

This sits at the **preferred** position under NOSOLICIT ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so there is nothing to narrow and no fallback language is needed.
